description: A grid of glass icons that refract the color behind them; for docks, app grids, and social links.
interactionNotes: On hover the glass lifts or presses in with a spring, the colored card behind it drifts gently with the cursor, and the glass edge catches light; a click presses it too. Tab focus shows the same hover state. `prefers-reduced-motion` makes all of this instant.

props.items: The icons. Each item takes `icon`, `label`, and `color`, and optionally `href`, `target`, `onClick`, `id`, and `className`. `color` is either the name of a ready gradient (blue, purple, red, indigo, orange, green, teal, pink, graphite, silver) or any CSS color/gradient.
props.size: Width and height of each icon in px.
props.columns: How many icons per row. If they do not fit, the row wraps and moves to fewer columns.
props.roundness: Corner roundness; from 0 square to 1 circle.
props.refraction: Light refraction at the glass edge — it bends what is behind it around the rim. Works only in Chromium browsers; the rest fall back to a regular blur.
props.bevel: Width of the glass's curved edge, from 0 to 1.
props.dispersion: The rim's iridescence that splits the light; from 0 to 1.
props.frost: Glass fog — how blurred what is behind it looks; from 0 to 1.
props.shine: Intensity of the light catch on the glass edge; from 0 to 1.
props.tintOpacity: How much `tint` colors the glass; from 0 to 1.
props.iconColor: Icon color on the glass. The default is white; on clear glass in a light theme it becomes near-black.
props.plate: Shape of the colored layer behind the glass: tilted card, offset card, circle, or none — which makes the glass fully clear.
props.tilt: Angle of the tilted card in degrees.
props.spread: How far the offset card or circle pokes out from behind the glass; from 0 to 1.
props.hover: Hover animation: `lift` raises the glass and tilts the card, `float` only raises it, `press` presses it in.
props.parallax: How far the card behind the glass moves with the cursor; from 0 to 1.
props.labels: When the label under the icon appears.
props.intro: The first time the icons come into view, the glass settles and the cards pop out one by one.
props.theme: Color of the labels and the glass edge.
props.className: Extra class for the main container.
props.style: Inline style for the main container.
props.ref: Imperative handle with `hover(index, on, aim?)` — a virtual hover on one cell without a real pointer; for preview drivers and storytelling.

tips: It has no dependencies — the springs are written with raw rAF and the shader with raw WebGL2; where WebGL2 is unavailable it falls back to the DOM version on its own.
True light refraction (liquid glass) is only visible in Chrome and Edge; Safari and Firefox show the same scene with blur and a shine map.
For fully clear glass, set `plate` to `none` — then whatever is behind the component (image, gradient, card) gets bent and becomes meaningful; on a flat background nothing is visible.
For a dock, raise `columns` and lower `gap` — the `dock` preset in the demo does exactly this.
The geometry (card tilt, bulge direction) is deliberately not mirrored; in right-to-left only the texts become Persian and the motion physics stays the same.
